title: The Hollow Static
author: Yara Joubert
blurb: Freya Thornbury, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
